A Different Approach How Functional Medicine Treats the Root Cause Conventional medicine manages disease after it appears. Functional medicine finds and fixes the root cause before symptoms become chronic conditions. Root Cause vs. Symptom Management Your PCP treats fatigue with stimulants, anxiety with SSRIs, weight gain with diet advice, and pain with NSAIDs. Functional medicine asks why all four are happening at once. Often, a single root cause like thyroid dysfunction, gut permeability, or cortisol dysregulation is driving every symptom on your list. One root cause can drive multiple symptoms Testing reveals what generic treatment misses Fewer medications, better outcomes Advanced Diagnostics The Gut-Brain Connection Personalized Treatment Plans What We Treat Symptoms We Commonly Treat These are the conditions patients come to us with most often. Functional medicine looks for the root cause of your symptoms instead of prescribing a different medication for each one. At Med Matrix, that means running 80+ lab markers, reading them against optimal ranges instead of population averages, and building one protocol that targets the upstream problem. When the root cause is treated, multiple symptoms often resolve together. How is functional medicine different from naturopathy or integrative medicine? The biggest difference is the testing. We order panels most providers never see: DUTCH hormone profiles, comprehensive stool analysis, organic acids, reverse T3, and inflammatory markers. Those results drive a systems-level protocol, not a generic wellness plan. What conditions does functional medicine treat? The patients who benefit most are dealing with chronic fatigue, brain fog, thyroid disorders, autoimmune disease, gut problems, hormonal imbalances, unexplained weight gain, chronic pain, and metabolic dysfunction. The common thread is that their conventional labs came back ‘normal’ but they still feel terrible. How long does it take to see results? Most patients notice measurable changes in energy and mental clarity within 4 to 8 weeks. More layered cases involving autoimmune conditions or long-standing gut dysfunction typically take 3 to 6 months. What kind of testing does Med Matrix use? We run panels your PCP has almost certainly never ordered. DUTCH testing maps how your body produces, metabolizes, and clears hormones. Comprehensive stool analysis evaluates your gut microbiome. Organic acids testing reveals mitochondrial function. We also test reverse T3, sex hormone binding globulin, full nutrient panels, and inflammatory markers. Do I need a referral from my primary care doctor? No. You do not need a referral to become a patient at Med Matrix. You can schedule directly. Will I have to stop seeing my regular doctor? Not at all. Many of our patients keep their PCP for acute care while working with us on the chronic symptoms their PCP could not explain. The two approaches complement each other. What does the first appointment look like? Your initial visit is 60+ minutes. Your provider reviews your complete health timeline, current symptoms, past labs, medications, diet, sleep, and stress patterns. Most patients say it is the first time a provider actually sat and listened. Is functional medicine just supplements? No. Supplements may be one piece, but your protocol can also include dietary changes, hormone optimization, peptide therapy, IV nutrition, and lifestyle modifications. Everything is chosen based on what your labs reveal. Can functional medicine help if I have already tried everything? That is actually the most common profile we see. The reason we find answers where others did not is simple: we test markers they never ordered, and we read the results against tighter ranges. A TSH of 4.0 is ‘normal’ in conventional medicine but high enough to cause fatigue, weight gain, and brain fog.
